metadata.title: Customer Create Page with Form Wizard

story.iWant: to create a new customer using a guided multi-step wizard
story.soThat: I can add customers with minimal errors

tasks.task: Create wizard layout and step management (AC: #1, #2)
Implement form state management and navigation (AC: #6, #7, #9)
Implement API integration for customer creation (AC: #10)
Implement success/error handling and user feedback (AC: #11, #12, #13)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Multi-step wizard with progress indicator showing Step N of 4
Step 1: Basic Info - first name, last name, date of birth fields with validation
Step 2: Contact - email (required, unique, valid format), phone (optional, valid format)
Step 3: Address - street, city, state (dropdown), zip code (5-6 digits) fields
Step 4: Review - read-only display of all entered data with Edit buttons per section
Form fields with real-time validation feedback, error messages inline
Next button disabled if current step has validation errors
Previous button always enabled (can go back to any step)
Confirm button creates customer via API (POST /api/v1/customers)
Loading state while creating (spinner, button disabled)
Success message with customer ID and options: View Customer, Create Another, Go to Dashboard
Error handling for duplicate email and validation errors with clear messages
Keyboard support: Tab navigation through form, Enter submits (on review step)

constraint.rule: Use react-hook-form or similar for managing form state across steps. Preserve form data when navigating between steps (don't reset on next/previous).
Validate current step before allowing Next button. Don't submit entire form until Review step. Allow Previous without validation.
Use MUI Stepper component to show current step. Display "Step N of 4" text. Disable previous steps (user can only go back via Previous button, not by clicking steps).
Review step is read-only. Show all entered data grouped by section (Basic Info, Contact, Address). Provide Edit button for each section to jump back to that step.
If API returns 409 Conflict for duplicate email, show error message: "A customer with this email already exists". Do NOT proceed to success page.
After successful creation, show success page with customer ID, three action buttons (View Customer, Create Another, Go to Dashboard). No redirect immediately.

interface.signature: createCustomer(data: CreateCustomerRequest): Promise<Customer> - posts to POST /api/v1/customers
interface.description: API wrapper for creating new customer. Story 3.6 calls this on Review step confirmation to create customer with all entered data.

interface.name: react-hook-form API
interface.signature: useForm, useFieldArray, useWatch hooks for multi-step form management
interface.description: Form state management library used to maintain wizard form state across steps, validation, and error handling.

interface.name: MUI Stepper Component
interface.signature: Stepper, Step, StepLabel from @mui/material for progress indication
interface.description: Material-UI stepper component for displaying multi-step form progress and current step.

tests.standards: Unit tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Test each wizard step in isolation, form state persistence across steps, validation at each step, and success/error flows.

ideas.idea: Verify wizard page loads at /customers/create route
Verify progress indicator shows "Step 1 of 4" and updates as user navigates
Verify each step renders with correct form fields and labels
Verify real-time validation on each field; error messages appear/disappear
Verify Next button disabled if current step has validation errors
Verify Previous button always enabled; navigating back preserves form data
Verify Review step displays all entered data read-only with Edit buttons
Verify Confirm button calls API to create customer with all wizard data
Verify loading spinner appears while API call in progress
Verify success page displays with customer ID and action buttons
Verify duplicate email error message displays, stays on Review step
Verify keyboard navigation (Tab through fields) and Enter submits on Review step
